com.vector.annotations.publishedapi

Annotation Type PublishedFilter


  • @Documented
 @Retention(value=CLASS)
 @Target(value={METHOD,CONSTRUCTOR,TYPE,FIELD})
 @PublishedApi(value=CLASS_DEPENDENCY)
 @Repeatable(value=PublishedFilterContainer.class)
public @interface PublishedFilter
    The PublishedFilter allows to filter classes, method and field (now called element) with a filter predicate of type PublishedFilterValue. Multiple filters are combined with AND logic. The filter predicate defines where the element shall be visible.

    This can be used for example to filter a certain element only usable in the MSR platform (AUTOSAR classic).

    Usage example: 

     
 @PublishedApi(ChangePolicy.ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 public interface MyInterface {

   @PublishedMethod
   @PublishedFilter(AMsrPlatform.class)
   void methodForAMsr(); // The method is only visible in AMSR.

   @PublishedMethod
   @PublishedFilter(MsrPlatform.class)
   void methodForMsr(); // The method is only visible in MSR.
 }

    The PublishedFilter annotation shall not be used by clients using the published API. This is only for the export and tracking of the published API. So a client shall not annotate any class or interface with the PublishedApi annotation.
